text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, voices 
could be heard coming from a classroom.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ can I take a break? Listening to all 
these explanations is making my head 
spin~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you just take a break a moment ago? 
Come now, focus!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san, you're super cute, so I really 
think you should smile moooore☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If you would focus and listen to what I am 
teaching, I would be smiling as well...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, triangles and lines of formulas and 
stuff are just total gibberish to me...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If it were related to Umadol stuff like 
dancing or singing, I could totally 
concentrate though~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then please try replacing those Umadol 
activities with your studies.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Tests are live performances, lessons are 
study sessions. Not understanding formulas 
and failing to focus would mean...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, an Umadol who doesn't memorize the 
lyrics...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aaaahhh!! Th-Then! The way I am right now 
is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That is so no-no-no-way!! As an Umadol, 
that's totally unforgivable!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
An Umadol must never cut corners and 
always shine with every ounce of her 
soul!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! Then you understand what you 
need to do now, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Lesson time☆ I gotta go straight to 
dance practice!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
............My efforts were insufficient. 
Is there anyone who could convince her...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. If you would not mind, could 
you please offer her some advice...?
choice_data_list: Don't cut corners on your studies either
Give it your all toward your dream!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehh, back to studying after all~...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Do not be so discouraged. Studying is just 
like lessons—if you put in the work, you 
will master it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you never cut corners on 
anything, correct?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, well as an Umadol I definitely 
believe in never cutting corners on 
anything! But, like, y'know...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, in the first place, 'anything' 
inherently encompasses 'every single 
matter'—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I keep telling you, those kinds of 
explanations are way too hard for meee~!

While letting out cries of despair, Smart 
Falcon managed to thoroughly get through 
her studies.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's it! To shine with every fiber of my 
being, it's time for dance practice today 
too~☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no. That is not what I meant by 
those words—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah... we were scheduled to study for 
another 39 minutes... My schedule...

Though Smart Falcon fled from her studies, 
she apparently gave her absolute all in 
her dance lessons...
